## script to keep only the longest isoform of the gene extracted from the "codon_aln.fa.gz" file from TOGAII

### This script calls for the python script"long_isoform.py"

```{bash, eval = false}

#!/bin/bash -l
#SBATCH -J remove_duplicates
#SBATCH --mail-type FAIL,END
#SBATCH --mail-user Julia.Levinstein@campus.lmu.de
#SBATCH -t 2-00:00:00
#SBATCH --clusters=biohpc_gen
#SBATCH --partition=biohpc_gen_normal
#SBATCH -n 4
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=8


#1.Variables set up
GENES="autosomal_genes" #neo, ancestral or autosomal
CLADE="Meliphagidae"
DATA_DIR="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project"
WORKING_DIR="/dss/dsslegfs01/pr53da/pr53da-dss-0036/projects/2025__neosex/neosex_project/fusion_dating"
GENE_LIST="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/chr4_list.txt" #gene list txt file containing the genes you would like to remove the duplicates
SPECIES_LIST="$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species_list" #species list txt file containing the species in which you would like the script to run on




for SPECIES in $(cat "$SPECIES_LIST"); do
    for GENE in $(cat "$GENE_LIST"); do
        # Check if the file exists
        if [ -f "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}" ]; then
            # Count headers; only run if count is greater than 1 (if there are more than one isoform)
            if [ $(grep -c ">" "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}") -gt 1 ]; then
                python3 "$DATA_DIR/Psittaciformes/Scripts/long_isoform_v2.py" "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}" > "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}_filter"

               mv "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}_filter" "$WORKING_DIR/$CLADE/$GENES/Species/$SPECIES/${GENE}"
            fi
        fi
    done
done

```
